name: TBILLEQ
description: TBILLEQ returns the bond-equivalent yield for a Treasury bill, allowing comparison with bond yields.
tldr: Calculates the bond-equivalent yield for a Treasury bill.

basicExample.explanation: Converts a 5% T-bill discount rate to a bond-equivalent yield of about 5.18%.

advancedExamples.title: Short-term T-bill
advancedExamples.explanation: For short-term T-bills, the conversion can be significant.

howItWorks: TBILLEQ converts the T-bill discount rate to a bond-equivalent yield using the formula (365 * discount) / (360 - discount * days to maturity). This allows comparison with coupon-bearing bonds.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Maturity must be within one year of settlement.
Discount is entered as a decimal.
Uses actual/365 day count for the conversion.

commonErrors.cause: Maturity is more than one year after settlement or discount is invalid.
commonErrors.fix: Verify dates are within one year and discount is a valid decimal.
Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: TBILLEQ works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the bond-equivalent yield?
faq.answer: It is a yield measure that allows comparison of T-bills with coupon-bearing bonds.

faq.question: What is the difference between TBILLEQ and TBILLYIELD?
faq.answer: TBILLEQ converts the discount rate to a bond-equivalent yield. TBILLYIELD calculates the yield based on the price.
